text:
The median asking rent in Nuremberg stands at 12.89 €/m², up 4.0 % year‑on‑year and 23.3 % over the past five years, placing the city 14th among the 37 most expensive markets. The 60 m² rent averages 773 € per month, while the rent‑burden for two residents is 17.1 % of income.

With a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and 31 days on market, the sector remains balanced but tight; 18 % of listings are let within a week. Asking rents sit 57 % above existing rents (8.21 €/m²), reflecting limited supply and modest population growth of 1.5 % over five years.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 13.55 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 13.24 €/m² and 13.85 €/m², a 5.1 % increase.
